operator_instruction.text: seating / queue_handoff / start 都是 HELD 這個 bug 改掉
operator_instruction.meaning: Discord seating, queue_handoff, and start must use STARTED, not QUEUE HELD

trigger.root_cause: pre_child_notifications and p1/p2 host seating sent --status held because the notifier had no start status. Acceptance tests froze that mapping.

allowed: Add Discord --status start and render seating/queue_handoff/start as STARTED.
Switch pre_child_notifications and host seating to --status start.
Re-pin 033 notification_receipts.notifier_sha256 and inputs[9] to the amended notifier.
forbidden: Change data, checkpoint, subset, seed, hyperparameters, CFG, or queue order.
Re-pin completed contracts (030-032) whose delivered receipts bind the previous notifier sha.

receipt_migration.reason: contract_sha256 changed with the notifier re-pin; deliver_required would reject a later seat/start/handoff whose stored binding still has the previous contract hash.
